retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical, intricate gold geometric frame on a dark background, blending Art Deco elegance with industrial fantasy motifs.
excludeWhen: bright or pastel color schemes are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex, multi-layered gold metallic frame composed of sharp angles and concentric circles, centered on a dark, textured void with subtle cosmic lighting. The design features a heavy emphasis on symmetry and architectural linework, creating a sense of mechanical luxury.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical interlocking of circular and angular gold linework
High-contrast relationship between metallic gold and deep charcoal/navy background
Central circular focal point framed by outer rectangular and diamond motifs
Subtle glowing blue accents contrasting with warm gold tones
coreInvariants: Beveled metallic texture on all linework
Dark, vignetted background with faint nebular textures
Geometric diamond-shaped nodes at cardinal points

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centralized circular void occupying 60% of the canvas width, surrounded by a full-bleed geometric frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large central text area and the glowing blue diamond icon on the horizontal divider.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Inward from the corners along the diagonal lines toward the central circle, then downward to the secondary metadata text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep dark void in the center and between the frame layers to provide breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation background with high-value, high-contrast metallic foreground elements.

characterSpecificRedesigns: A with a low crossbar and sharp apex
R with an open or detached leg
E with equal length horizontal strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair a heavy, chiseled display face with a clean, wide-tracked secondary sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines with central diamond icon
Corner brackets with interlocking geometric paths

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the wide, sturdy base suitable for metallic beveling.
Geometric and wide, fits the industrial-deco aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark navy background with a subtle central nebula glow. Overlay a symmetrical gold Art Deco frame consisting of concentric circles and sharp geometric corner filigree with a beveled metallic texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, wide-tracked, beveled gold text in the center. Add a horizontal divider line with a glowing blue diamond in the middle, followed by smaller sans-serif metadata text below.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a 3D chiseled appearance?
Is the tracking wide enough to feel cinematic?
Is there a subtle blue glow at the center point?

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean vector-like lines for the frame
Consistent 3D lighting across all gold elements
avoid: Flat, untextured yellow instead of gold

postGenerationChecks: Check for bilateral symmetry in the frame
Verify the blue accent glow is subtle and centered
Confirm the typography is centered and wide-tracked
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Gold Geometric Frame + Dark Nebula Background + Beveled Wide Sans-Serif Typography + Cyan Glow Accents
